title: Skillspector: overview film
description: Check skills before agents use them. A narrated tour, recorded in this TYPO3 v14 lab, with English captions.
alt: Overview film, 48 seconds: Skillspector for TYPO3 v14. Evidence, line by line; Hiding a skill is your call. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: A skill is text your AI agent follows. One hidden line can leak a key or pipe a script into a shell.
Skillspector reads every agent skill before your AI does.
Each finding shows its severity, its location, the matched text and what to check.
Checks never change a skill. An administrator decides what to hide.
Fifteen built-in rules look for prompt injection, exposed keys, risky commands and licence problems.
